en.title: Denzel, Robert, Daisy Unite for Netflix Heist Thriller 'The Take'
en.summary: A star-studded Netflix heist thriller is deep in post-production, bringing together acting titans Denzel Washington and Robert Pattinson with Daisy Edgar-Jones. 'The Take' promises a high-stakes game of deception, and here's what we know.
en.body:
Get ready for a cinematic event that has been brewing behind the scenes for some time. **Denzel Washington**, **Robert Pattinson**, and **Daisy Edgar-Jones** are set to star in Netflix's upcoming heist thriller, **'The Take'**. Formerly known as **'Here Comes the Flood'**, the film has wrapped principal photography and is currently deep in post-production, positioning it as a major release for the streamer, potentially in 2027.

The project is helmed by acclaimed director **Fernando Meirelles**, known for his masterful work on **'City of God'**, and penned by **Simon Kinberg**, the creative force behind franchises like **'X-Men'** and **'Deadpool'**. Kinberg also produces through his Genre Films banner, alongside **Audrey Chon**. The simple yet intriguing synopsis hints at a tangled web of deceit: "A bank guard, a teller, and a master thief get caught in a deadly game of cons and double crosses."

This marks a significant entry for **Denzel Washington** into the world of Netflix Originals, as his previous streaming presence has been limited to documentaries and archival features. With an unparalleled career boasting multiple Academy Awards, Washington’s involvement alone elevates **'The Take'** to must-watch status. **Robert Pattinson**, whose eclectic career has seen him move from blockbuster franchises to critically acclaimed indie darlings, adds another layer of intrigue. Meanwhile, **Daisy Edgar-Jones**, fresh off successes like **'Twisters'** and upcoming projects such as **'Sense and Sensibility'**, continues to solidify her position as one of Hollywood's most compelling actresses.

## A Masterclass in Deception

The confluence of these talents suggests a film that will lean heavily into intricate plotting and character-driven suspense. **Meirelles**'s directorial vision, combined with **Kinberg**'s knack for genre storytelling, creates high expectations for a sophisticated heist narrative. The core premise, involving a bank guard, a teller, and a master thief, opens the door for multiple perspectives and betrayals, promising a dynamic viewing experience that will keep audiences guessing until the very end. The film's journey from conception to its current post-production phase, under the working title **'Here Comes the Flood'**, indicates a carefully crafted production aiming for maximum impact.

## What Fans Can Expect

For fans of intense thrillers and powerhouse performances, **'The Take'** represents a dream collaboration. The presence of **Washington**, **Pattinson**, and **Edgar-Jones** guarantees a level of acting prowess rarely seen together in a single project. The heist genre, when executed with skill, offers a potent blend of suspense, action, and psychological drama. Given the pedigree of the cast and crew, viewers can anticipate a tightly written script, sharp direction, and a visually compelling presentation. The film's status in post-production means that details regarding its official release date and promotional materials are likely to emerge soon, fueling anticipation within the fan community.

## What's Next

With principal photography concluded in early 2026 and the film now in post-production, the focus shifts to the final touches that will bring **'The Take'** to screens worldwide. Fans should keep an eye on official Netflix announcements for trailers, release dates, and further details about this highly anticipated thriller.

content_raw: Picture: Denzel Washington, Daisy Edgar-Jones and Robert Pattinson Set to be one of Netflix’s biggest releases of 2027 , the star-studded heist thriller The Take pairs Denzel Washington, Robert Pattinson, and Daisy Edgar-Jones in a high-stakes game of deception. With principal photography having wrapped in early 2026, the project is deep into post-production. Here’s our preview for The Take , including the cast list, behind-the-scenes images, and more. The Take (formerly Here Comes the Flood) is an upcoming Netflix Original heist thriller directed by Fernando Meirelles  (City of God) and written by Simon Kinberg (Deadpool) , who also produced it through his Genre Films banner alongside Audrey Chon. What is the plot of The Take ? All we have is a simple synopsis for The Take: “A bank guard, a teller, and a master thief get caught in a deadly game of cons and double crosses.” Who are the cast members of The Take ? The three leads of The Take are confirmed as Denzel Washington, Robert Pattinson, and Daisy Edgar-Jones. BLOOMFIELD, NJ – NOVEMBER 04: Denzel Washington on the set of “Here Comes The Flood” on November 4, 2025 in Bloomfield, N.J. United States. (Photo by Bobby Bank/GC Images) Denzel Washington has never starred in a Netflix original project; his streaming appearances are limited to interviews in Giving Voice and archival features like Piano Lesson: Legacy and a Vision and Ma Rainey’s Black Bottom: A Legacy Brought to Screen . As one of Hollywood’s top leading men, Washington boasts an illustrious career spanning dozens of acclaimed films, including Academy Award-winning performances in Glory (1989) and Training Day (2001). Picture: Daisy Edgar-Jones in Where the Crawdads Sing, Twisters and Sense and Sensibility  Daisy Edgar-Jones has not yet starred in a Netflix original. Her breakout role came in 2022 in Olivia Newman’s adaptation of Where the Crawdads Sing . Since then, she has starred in films such as Twisters and Sense and Sensibility , and in Hulu’s true-crime drama series Under the Banner of Heaven . BLOOMFIELD, NJ – NOVEMBER 04: Robert Pattinson on the set of “Here Comes The Flood” on November 4, 2025 in Bloomfield, N.J. United States. (Photo by Bobby Bank/GC Images) Robert Pattinson has starred in two Netflix titles: The King , where he played the Dauphin of France, and Devil All the Time, where he played Reverend Preston Teagarden. Pattinson is one of Hollywood’s most dynamic and busiest actors, and has starred in Christopher Nolan’s Tenet and The Odyssey , is the current Bruce Wayne/Batman, and starred as Chris Hansen in the biographical drama Primetime .
